queries.query: Add Clerk to our Next.js App Router app and protect /dashboard without blocking the landing page.
This repo has @clerk/nextjs and clerkMiddleware(), but server actions accept any orgId from the client. Fix the tenant access checks.
Wire authentication into our React Router SSR app and make the loader reject signed-out requests.
Our Clerk user.updated webhook sometimes runs twice and overwrites newer profile data. Make the sync safe.
Use Clerk Billing organization subscriptions to gate an API feature, not just the button.
Set up Playwright auth for the app that uses ClerkProvider and keep prod credentials out of CI.
Add Clerk passkey sign-in to our Expo app and verify the backend accepts the resulting session.
Migrate our Auth0 tenant to rotating refresh tokens and update the callback handler.
Design email and password authentication for a new Go API. We have not picked an identity provider.
Add Stripe subscription tiers and enforce them in our API.
Model role-based access control for our internal PostgreSQL users table.
Verify GitHub webhook signatures and deduplicate push events.
Set up Convex Auth with password reset and protected queries. Do not use an external auth provider.
Write a job description for a part-time records clerk at a medical office.
Protect a Fastify endpoint with the official Clerk SDK and return a real forbidden response when the member lacks permission.
The organization switcher changes the active organization, but users can still fetch another tenant's records by editing the URL. Review our Clerk authorization boundary.
Our Vercel preview accidentally uses the production CLERK_SECRET_KEY and redirects to the wrong domain. Repair the environment contract.
Upgrade an old @clerk/nextjs integration that still uses deprecated middleware, but check the installed version before changing imports.
Use the official Clerk Go SDK to verify sessions and authorize organization membership in an HTTP handler.
Implement WorkOS organizations, invitations, and SSO in our SaaS.
Build a custom OpenID Connect provider for our appliance fleet.
Our hand-written session cookie is missing SameSite and expires too early. Fix it.
Implement biometric unlock for locally encrypted data in an Android app. There is no remote identity provider.
Rotate API keys for our internal metrics collector and update Kubernetes secrets.
